summary: Wrote a 6-phase, ~5-hour implementation plan for reclassifying bare whole-tree git stash as destructive. The plan amends the wrong premise in rules/git-workflow.md first (Items 1, 7, 8 verdicts recorded), then adds a per-segment stash_revert detector to hooks/guard-destructive-git.sh with a class-conditional refusal naming git show HEAD:path, git diff HEAD -- path, and a scratchpad copy. It wires the new class into BOTH existing escape-hatch registration points (PG_ACTION_CLASSES validation and please-grant.sh mint grammar) with no second mechanism, lands a fixture demonstrated red pre-change and green post-change, and ends with deploy regeneration plus the full gate set.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan: rule amendment first, then stash_revert guard detector, dual escape-hatch wiring, red-then-green fixture, redeploy.
